name: the-high-council
description: A planning council: models from different labs propose, debate and review one plan. Bring your own keys.
long_description:
The High Council runs one request past seats filled by models from different labs. Each lab proposes blind, the proposals are debated on the record, one plan is built and reviewed under a round cap, and the run folder keeps every stage.

**Bring your own keys.** Nothing is hosted and there is no default key: add a key only for the labs you want to seat. The `mock` chains run offline, free, with no key at all, so you can try the tools first.

**Spend ceiling.** Every run stops before any stage that could pass the ceiling you set here. Claude cannot lift it from a conversation.

No claim is made that a council produces better plans than one model; nothing has measured that yet.

tools.name: list_chains
tools.description: Chains available to run, with a description and worst-case price each.

tools.name: dry_run
tools.description: Price a chain without calling any model.

tools.name: write_task
tools.description: Write a task file under tasks/ for the council to plan against.

tools.name: start_run
tools.description: Start a run in the background under the per-run spend ceiling.

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: Where a run stands: stage, verdicts, scoreboard, cost.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Runs on disk, newest first, with state and cost.

tools.name: read_run_file
tools.description: Read a file from a run folder (deliverable.md, BOARD.md, HANDOFF.md, report.json and others).

tools.name: plan_outline
tools.description: Section tree of a run's deliverable with word counts.

tools.name: resume_run
tools.description: Resume a paused run, or one the spend ceiling stopped.

tools.name: external_prompt
tools.description: The prompt a run paused at an external seat is waiting on.

tools.name: prepare_stage_prompt
tools.description: Write a self-contained prompt file for a paused external stage.

tools.name: submit_stage
tools.description: Answer a paused external stage and resume the run.

tools.name: spend_report
tools.description: What runs have cost across a window of days, read from disk.

tools.name: verdict_stats
tools.description: Descriptive statistics on sign-offs, rounds and objections across runs.

tools.name: metrics_report
tools.description: Descriptive telemetry from run logs. Not an evaluation or benchmark.

workdir.title: Council folder
workdir.description: Where task files and run folders (deliverable.md, BOARD.md, HANDOFF.md, report.json) are written. Runs can hold sensitive plans; pick a private folder.

max_usd.title: Spend ceiling per run (USD)
max_usd.description: A run stops before any stage that could take it past this, billed to your own keys. Claude cannot raise or remove it from a chat; change it here.
